name: @ai-substrate/dd
description: dd — deterministic documents: validate, render, address, and inspect structured docs.
$comment: exports — the ratified plan-002 surface (design-decision.md D-1..D-6, o-prime 2026-08-08). Every subpath is an import specifier OBSERVED in a consumer, mapped explicitly rather than by wildcard so that what is public is a list somebody chose. '.' is a CURATED PURE BARREL (dist/lib.js): importing the package used to execute the CLI and yield zero named exports, which is the canonical dual-package defect. The bin is unchanged and is no longer reachable through the map. './node' is the host-bound tier — NodeSchemaFs, trackedPaths, DdActDeps, DD_ISSUE_CODES, renderDocument — named so a consumer can tell whether an import costs it a host dependency; the last two land there by ratified amendment A-1 because dd's architecture gate forbids the SDK tree from reaching 'output/' or an adapter. './plan' is DELIBERATELY ABSENT: R-2 rules that plan/ does not ship. './acts/*' is never exported. Reachability is proven, not declared — scripts/exports-reachability-probe.mjs.
$comment-overrides: postcss pins nanoid ^3.x and the newest 3.x our screened feed carries is 3.3.17, which the advisory covers (<3.3.18). 3.3.18 exists publicly and the feed 404s on it, so there is no rollback out of this: EVERY postcss needs a nanoid the feed cannot supply clean. nanoid 5.1.16 IS in the feed, ships a CJS entry, and postcss's own nanoid path (parse + source map) was exercised against it before this landed.
